required_before_work: Read all Markdown files under .ai_memory in full.
Read projectbrief.md first and activeContext.md second.
Check activeContext.md for any open [WIP], [AWAITING_QA], or [REWORK] item.
Classify the task as L0/L1/L2/L3 before execution.
Use reduce-interruption mode: make conservative assumptions for non-critical decisions and continue unless a hard blocker exists.
Stop at the plan stage and ask for confirmation before any L2/L3 or other high-risk action.
Read the latest physical snapshot of every target file before editing.
Separate confirmed facts, grounded inferences, and open questions in working notes or final conclusions.
Do not mark work as complete without execution evidence.
After verified completion, commit and push source changes with a clear Chinese commit message when the repository, remote, and permissions are available.
Keep local backups under .archive/ and keep runtime artifacts ignored by Git.

file_roles.projectbrief.md: Business charter, scope, goals, hard constraints, risk areas, and compatibility boundaries.
file_roles.activeContext.md: Current state, task grading, active lock, next action, blockers, validation plan, and execution evidence.
file_roles.agentRules.md: Mandatory agent behavior rules, risk protocol, editing discipline, and completion protocol.
file_roles.systemPatterns.md: Stable system-wide engineering conventions and design norms.
file_roles.techContext.md: Environment, stack, commands, and operational constraints.
file_roles.decisionLog.md: Long-term decisions, rationale, rejected alternatives, and rollback notes.
file_roles.backlog.md: Open debts, pending regressions, future work, and documentation tasks.
file_roles.pitfalls.md: Known traps, invalid assumptions, and previously failed approaches.
file_roles.interfaces.md: Critical API, schema, auth, and data contract summaries.
file_roles.progress.md: Verified milestones, completion evidence, residual risk notes, and archived history.
file_roles.architecture.md: System structure, module ownership, data flow, and boundary map.
